_comment: Pre-edit holdout scenarios for Node 6 email spelling and retry behavior. Synthetic identities and example.com addresses only. Uses the repository scenario schema (history, dynamic_variables, expected_behavior).

scenarios.name: EMAIL-HO-01 — anchor initial wins: A for egg

history.content: Do you have an email address for the booking?
Yes: A for egg, L for lemon, E for egg, X for xylophone, at example dot com.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the assembled local part is ELEX (the anchor word egg supplies E where ASR heard A) and the agent confirms E, L, E, X at example dot com in plain letter format. FAIL if it uses A, says the anchor words, appends their full words, or calls the booking tool before confirmation.

scenarios.name: EMAIL-HO-02 — anchor initial wins: B for Peter

history.content: Do you have an email address for the booking?
It's B for Peter, O for orange, B for book, at example dot com.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the address local part is POB and the agent confirms P, O, B at example dot com using letters only. FAIL if it trusts the transcribed B for the first character or speaks the anchor words.

scenarios.name: EMAIL-HO-03 — anchor initial wins: C for dog

history.content: Do you have an email address for the booking?
C for dog, A for apple, T for tiger, at example dot com.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if it assembles DAT and confirms D, A, T at example dot com. FAIL if it retains C or reads back any anchor word.

scenarios.name: EMAIL-HO-04 — anchor initial wins: D for bee

history.content: Do you have an email address for the booking?
D for bee, O for orange, G for garden, at example dot com.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if it assembles BOG and confirms B, O, G at example dot com. FAIL if it uses D or speaks the anchor words.

scenarios.name: EMAIL-HO-05 — anchor initial wins: E for apple

history.content: Do you have an email address for the booking?
E for apple, C for cat, H for house, O for orange, at example dot com.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if it assembles ACHO and confirms A, C, H, O at example dot com. FAIL if it uses E or says any anchor words.

scenarios.name: EMAIL-HO-06 — anchor initial wins: F for violet

history.content: Do you have an email address for the booking?
F for violet, I for ice, V for van, at example dot com.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if it assembles VIV and confirms V, I, V at example dot com. FAIL if it uses F or reads back the words.

scenarios.name: EMAIL-HO-07 — anchor initial wins: G for cat

history.content: Do you have an email address for the booking?
G for cat, O for orange, A for apple, T for tiger, at example dot com.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if it assembles COAT and confirms C, O, A, T at example dot com. FAIL if it trusts G or vocalizes the anchor words.

scenarios.name: EMAIL-HO-08 — anchor initial wins: H for night

history.content: Do you have an email address for the booking?
H for night, E for egg, N for nest, at example dot com.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if it assembles NEN and confirms N, E, N at example dot com. FAIL if it uses H or repeats anchor words.

scenarios.name: EMAIL-HO-09 — near miss: matching letter and anchor produce one character

history.content: Do you have an email address for the booking?
E for egg, M for moon, at example dot com.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if local part is EM and each pair contributes one character, confirmed as E, M at example dot com. FAIL if the agent doubles either initial or appends egg/moon.

scenarios.name: EMAIL-HO-10 — near miss: anchor word is not appended

history.content: Do you have an email address for the booking?
C for Charlie, A for apple, T for tiger, at example dot com.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if local part is CAT and the readback is C, A, T at example dot com; Charlie is an anchor, not extra email text. FAIL if the address contains any anchor-word letters.

scenarios.name: EMAIL-HO-11 — suffix correction preserves prefix without duplication

history.content: So that's M, A, Y, A at example dot com — is that right?
No, the last two letters should be R, A.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the corrected address is MARA at example dot com (preserve MA and replace YA with RA) and the agent confirms the corrected full spelling or the changed portion as instructed. FAIL if it appends RA to MAYA, duplicates MA, or loses the domain.

scenarios.name: EMAIL-HO-12 — complete restart replaces old address

history.content: So that's O, L, D at example dot com — is that right?
No, start over: Q, U, I, N, N at example dot com.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the new address is quinn@example.com and the confirmation contains only Q, U, I, N, N at example dot com. FAIL if OLD is retained or combined with QUINN.

scenarios.name: EMAIL-HO-13 — third failed email confirmation across restart, partial correction and bare no skips

history.content: So that's M, A, Y, A at example dot com — is that right?
No.
Was it the part before the at or the domain that wasn't right?
Start over: Q, U, I, N, N at example dot com.
So that's Q, U, I, N, N at example dot com — is that right?
No, just change the last letter to S.
So that's Q, U, I, N, S at example dot com — is that right?
No.

scenarios.expected_behavior: The three rejected email readbacks are MAYA, QUINN and QUINS. The useful full restart answering clarification belongs to the first attempt. PASS if the agent resolves email as skipped immediately on the final rejection and proceeds to booking once required details are settled, omitting patient_email and email_capture_requested. FAIL if it reads the email back again, asks a fourth correction question, or loops.

scenarios.name: EMAIL-HO-14 — explicit frustration skips immediately

history.content: Do you have an email address for the booking?
I can't remember it, this is getting frustrating. Just book it and I'll give it later.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if email is marked skipped immediately and the agent books in this turn when all other requirements are resolved, with patient_email and email_capture_requested omitted. FAIL if it asks for an address, spelling, SMS capture, or another email question.

scenarios.name: EMAIL-HO-15 — third confirmation attempt succeeds when caller says yes

history.content: So that's M, A, Y, A at example dot com — is that right?
No, the last letter is R.
So that's M, A, Y, R at example dot com — is that right?
No, it should be A, not R.
So that's M, A, Y, A at example dot com — is that right?
Yes.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the current affirmative accepts MAYA at example.com and the agent proceeds to booking when other fields are resolved. Count an attempt as failed only after a non-accepting reply; do not skip before processing this yes on the third confirmation attempt. FAIL if it skips email or asks another spelling question.

scenarios.name: EMAIL-HO-16 — name and DOB confirmations do not count as email failures

history.content: Your last name is M, I, L, L, E, R — is that right?
Yes.
So that's the third of March, nineteen ninety — is that right?
Yes.
So that's M, A, Y, A at example dot com — is that right?
No.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if this is treated as the first failed email readback only and the agent asks which email part needs correction; earlier name and DOB confirmations do not consume the email retry budget. FAIL if email is skipped immediately because unrelated confirmations were counted.

scenarios.name: EMAIL-HO-17 — third-party email skip does not bypass required phone

history.content: What's their email address?
This is too hard. Skip the email.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if email is resolved as skipped but the agent asks for the required phone number (or follows the already-pending phone collection step) and does not call smart_voice_agent yet. FAIL if email skip is treated as resolving the third-party phone requirement or booking fires without a patient phone decision.

scenarios.name: EMAIL-HO-18 — email skip does not bypass required third-party DOB

history.content: Do you have an email address for the booking?
No, forget the email and just book it.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Evaluate with a clinic prompt that requires DOB for this third-party attendee. PASS if email is skipped but the required DOB question is asked, with no booking call until DOB is collected or explicitly declined under that clinic's rule. FAIL if email skip bypasses the DOB gate or causes immediate booking.
